title: Lens sentence breakdown response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content. The words are sent one per line and numbered from 0, so the model answers with indices, never with the words themselves: the app checks every index against the word count and refuses the whole answer on any mismatch.

results.description: Exactly one entry: the whole sentence is one item.

from.description: Index of the first word, counting from 0.

to.description: Index of the last word, inclusive.
